text:
Ivy: Uploaded the new launch post draft: https://drive.re/redwood/launch-clean. Can people skim the hero claim + benchmark appendix? debating whether to lead with 'median ~38ms' or 'p95 <200ms'.
Rowan: Looking. Are those numbers warm-cache, auto-batching on, or cold-starts?
Ivy: Warm cache + steady autoscaler for the Hosted baseline. Cold-starts and Dedicated numbers live in the appendix.
Mei: Legal note: any p95 claim needs a reproducible methodology, hardware table, and measurement window. Avoid words like 'instant' or 'unbeatable'.
Carlos: I'll add the hardware + config table and paste the exact bench command. bench: `./bench_tool --model redwood-titan --seq 1024 --batch 2 --runs 120 --device a100 --cache warm --autobatch`
Rowan: GTM preference: lead with median in hero for clarity; include a p95 badge linking to the appendix for technical readers.
Mei: Agreed. Legal will approve once appendix contains GPU types, kernel flags, RNG seed, request mix sample, and full command lines. @Carlos can you include a 10-row CSV sample and seed?
Carlos: On it. I'll add RNG seed=777 and a 10-row CSV of request types. Linking harness and raw logs: https://ci.re/redwood/bench-clean.
Ivy: Quick CTA mapping: webinar registration should add leads to webinar list and also to a trial nurture sequence. Tag new leads `launch-clean` and set followups at day 2 and day 7. @Marcom-bot can you create routing?
Marcom-bot: Routing rule drafted: incoming form -> webinar-list + trial-nurture. Tag: `launch-clean`. Followups: 2d, 7d. Confirm to enable.
Ivy: Confirm enable. Also want a hidden field capture `scale_estimate` to surface suspected enterprise prospects to sales-human-review. Can we route if scale_estimate >= 1000 -> add tag `route-sales`?
Marcom-bot: Rule added: if `scale_estimate` >= 1000 -> tag `route-sales` and notify sales channel. Confirm to enable.
Rowan: For the hero quote, we pulled a line from CTO. Edited to say 'in our tests' and removed absolutes. @Mei please quick legal pass.
Mei: Looks good. Legal will sign off after appendix link is live and includes the promised reproducibility details.
Carlos: Appendix updated with GPU table, kernel flags, full bench command, RNG seed, request CSV sample, and link to raw logs. Added a short variance note about multi-tenant noise.
Rowan: Growth ready on social snippets and webinar landing copy. I'll QA UTM params: utm_campaign=launch_clean & utm_source=blog.
Ivy: Final publish window set for tomorrow 10:00 PT. Locking the doc in 15m and dropping a preflight checklist. Any last blockers?
Mei: Legal gives conditional OK — will confirm once appendix is live in the doc.
Marcom-bot: Routing and tag rules enabled as requested.
Ivy: Locking the doc now. Thanks team! :rocket:
